_comment: What the release gate lets through, each with why (the operator's decisions, 2026-11-20). Drive IDs and Docs links are never allowed. A web-app URL is named by a 12-hex scrypt fingerprint of '<domain>/s/<id>' (check.js's valueHash), never by the URL itself.

scriptUrls.what: The Student Dashboard web app (cas-ccps/data/deployment-urls.json's studentDashboardUrl). The Canvas assignments link students to it; it sits behind the school's sign-in.
